subject: Replace blocks with token field in json files (#832)
reason: The change only rewrites the command-spec JSON metadata files (ft.aggregate.json, ft.create.json, ft.search.json) from nested pure-token blocks to the compact token-field notation. These files are documentation/metadata artifacts: they are not listed in any CMakeLists, not embedded in the module binary, and no source file reads them; command parsing is implemented entirely in ft_*_parser.cc, which the diff does not touch, and the module never calls ValkeyModule_SetCommandInfo, so no server reply (COMMAND DOCS/INFO) or command behaviour can change. There is no reachable runtime behaviour to tes
